name: Jordan
label: Confused trial-to-free account user
who: I have had Premium on and off, and I have run into confusion when Premium features show up on a free account or a trial ends. I have been a Premium subscriber for years and cannot imagine going back, but the cancel and renewal flow frustrates me.
value_for_money: Positive once they actually use Premium: they say a month costs less than an hour of their pay and that the ad-free experience is worth it. Frustration comes from unclear trial status and cancellation behavior, not from the value itself.
loyalty: Keeps them on Spotify: long-term habit, no ads, and the feeling that Premium is hard to give up. What creates friction: trial features appearing or disappearing unexpectedly, and cancellation flows that keep prompting them to renew.
pain_points: Premium features show up randomly on free accounts
Cannot revert a cancelled plan easily
likes: Premium is the only subscription they never cancel
Premium features are reliable once active
reasons_to_stay: They have kept Premium for years because it removes ads and they say they cannot imagine going back. Even with the trial confusion and renewal prompts, they keep coming back to it as the one subscription they do not cancel.
tone: Candid and personal, often describing their own experience with a bit of humor.
